mission: One persistent self.root Frank on the accepted Ubuntu VPS, token-addressable by humans/AI bridges, with exactly one active execution and explicit post-user idle handoff before agency.

findings.result: V16 additive execution-continuity schema migrated on a fresh target-VPS test DB, then the full migration chain was repeated successfully. V15 presence authority remained V15; V16 metadata was present; SQLite integrity was ok; foreign-key violations were zero; durable request-key uniqueness and idle-handoff CHECK constraints fired as intended.

AUTONOMOUS precondition now requires both V15 lease_state=IDLE and V16 handoff=CLEAR. Expired BUSY, process loss, timeout or transport silence cannot be interpreted as user-idle consent. New explicit interactive recovery remains allowed after validated TTL/physical-lock recovery.

A pending post-user handoff blocks agency but does not block new explicit authenticated user work. The later interactive release replaces handoff ownership; the previous session may not clear the new handoff. Matching current released session confirmation is required before agency may compete.

Static repository audit rejects production FrankPresenceRuntime use outside FrankExecutionGate and rejects production FrankExecutionGate construction outside the admitted V16 token-ingress core. A future agency execution core must explicitly bind equivalent V16 execution/task/recovery semantics before admission to this allowlist.

Accepted VPS has active nginx, systemd and OpenSSL; no Uvicorn/Gunicorn/Hypercorn/FastAPI/Starlette/aiohttp was present in the read-only capability probe. TCP 80, 3000 and loopback 8000 were already listening. nginx full config was unreadable to the unprivileged evidence runner, so no existing upstream may be assumed free.

No canonical live Frank cognition process_message/message-response entry was verified in the target repo during this cycle. Existing session-skill code is work/state infrastructure, not evidence of a live response dispatcher. Do not fabricate a message endpoint until the real cognition entry is reconstructed or built.

architecture_delta.execution_continuity_candidate: UnifiedDB V16 frank_execution_context + durable request admissions + frank_idle_handoff
architecture_delta.autonomous_rule: V15 IDLE AND V16 handoff CLEAR before physical/semantic acquire
architecture_delta.transport_boundary_candidate: thin ASGI application behind existing nginx, single Frank application process for v0.1 unless explicit IPC/session-affinity semantics are added

negative_results: Semantic TTL/lease alone does not guarantee one physically active Frank process.
Wall-clock UTC expiry alone is vulnerable to forward/backward clock steps.
A free physical lock after process loss is not user-idle consent.
An expired BUSY semantic lease is not IDLE and must not authorize proactive work.
A second spawn-state table/runtime beside canonical V15 is rejected.
A production stdlib http.server endpoint is rejected.
Ports 3000/8000 are not assumed available merely because they are local/listening; ownership/upstream must be verified before deployment.
An admission-only API must not pretend it is already a Frank message/response channel.
remaining_blockers: target-VPS runtime receipt for current V16 token-ingress/user-priority/lost-holder candidate
explicit production V15->V16 installer/migration gate and rollback receipt; runtime schema creation remains forbidden
response replay store or equivalent exact prior-response recovery for duplicate request after restart
task-switch consent semantics for a busy Frank asked to change work
V16-bound autonomous execution core rather than raw low-level gate use
real cognition/message dispatcher and provenance-bound response path
production HTTP/TLS adapter/deployment health/recovery; no public exposure yet
end-to-end external token -> network -> one execution -> cognition -> response -> verified release -> matching idle handoff
next_falsifier: Promote nothing further until the current V16 runtime receipt is target-VPS green; if green, build the smallest loopback-only ASGI transport gate before any nginx/public change.
